readings.title: The Cosmic Singularity of the Creator
readings.subtitle: Profaning the Covenant Through Idolatrous Union
readings.text: [Malachi 2:10] Have we not all one Father? Did not one <dn>Ěl</dn> create us? Why do we act treacherously against one another, to profane <dn>את</dn> the covenant of the fathers? [11] Yehuḏah has acted treacherously, and an abomination has been done in Yisra’ěl and in Yerushalayim, for Yehuḏah has profaned what is set-apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – which <dn>He</dn> had loved – and has married the daughter of a foreign mighty one. [12] Let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> cut off from the tents of Ya‛aqoḇ the man who does this – stirring up or answering, and bringing an offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts!

readings.title: The Covenant of Companionship
readings.subtitle: The Divine Rejection of Treachery and Divorce
readings.text: [13] And this you have done a second time: you cover <dn>את</dn> the slaughter-place of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with tears, with weeping and crying, because <dn>He</dn> no longer regards the offering, nor receives it with pleasure from your hands. [14] And you said, “Why?” Because <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have acted treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant. [15] And did <dn>He</dn> not make one? And <dn>He</dn> had the remnant of the Spirit? And what is the one alone? <dn>He</dn> seeks a seed of <dn>Elohim</dn>. So you shall guard your spirit, and let none act treacherously against the wife of his youth. [16] <dq>“For <dn>I</dn> hate divorce,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl, <dq>“and the one who covers his garment with cruelty,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. <dq>“So you shall guard your spirit, and do not act treacherously.”</dq>

readings.title: The Distortion of Premial Justice
readings.subtitle: Wearying the Creator with Moral Relativism
readings.text: [17] You have wearied <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with your words, and you have said, “In what way have we wearied <dn>Him</dn>?” In that you say, “Everyone who does evil is good in the eyes of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and <dn>He</dn> is delighting in them,” or, “Where is the <dn>Elohim</dn> of right-ruling?”

readings.title: The Right Arm's Legal Operation
readings.subtitle: The Refiner’s Fire and the Restoration of Levi
readings.text: [Malachi 3:1] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am sending <dn>My</dn> messenger, and he shall prepare the way before <dn>Me</dn>. Then suddenly the Master you are seeking comes to <dn>His</dn> Hěḵal, even the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight. See, <dn>He</dn> is coming,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [2] “And who is able to bear the day of <dn>His</dn> coming, and who is able to stand when <dn>He</dn> appears? For <dn>He</dn> is like the fire of a refiner, and like the soap of a launderer. [3] “And <dn>He</dn> shall sit as a refiner and a cleanser of silver. And <dn>He</dn> shall cleanse <dn>את</dn> the sons of Lěvi, and refine <dn>את</dn> them as gold and silver, and they shall belong to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, bringing near an offering in righteousness. [4] “Then shall the offering of Yehuḏah and Yerushalayim be pleasant to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, as in the days of old, as in former years.

readings.title: The Swift Witness of Absolute Justice
readings.subtitle: Judgment Against Exploitation and Falsehood
readings.text: [5] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall draw near to you for right-ruling. And <dn>I</dn> shall be a swift witness against the practisers of witchcraft, and against adulterers, and against them that swear to falsehood, and against those who oppress the wage earner in his wages and widows and the fatherless, and those who turn away a sojourner and do not fear <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.

readings.title: The Immutable Framework
readings.subtitle: A Call to Return to the Cosmic Order
readings.text: [Malachi 3:6] <dq>“For <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> shall not change, and you, O sons of Ya‛aqoḇ, shall not come to an end.</dq> [7] <dq>“From the days of your fathers you have turned aside from <dn>My</dn> laws and did not guard them. Turn back to <dn>Me</dn>, and <dn>I</dn> shall turn back to you,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. “But you said, ‘In what shall we turn back?’

readings.title: The Architecture of the Divine Economy
readings.subtitle: The Reserved Tithe and the Rebuking of the Devourer
readings.text: [8] “Would a man rob <dn>Elohim</dn>? <dq>Yet you are robbing <dn>את</dn> <dn>Me</dn>!</dq> But you said, ‘In what have we robbed <dn>You</dn>?’ <dq>In the tithe and the offering!</dq> [9] <dq>“You have cursed <dn>Me</dn> with a curse, for you are robbing <dn>את</dn> <dn>Me</dn>, this nation, all of it!</dq> [10] <dq>“Bring <dn>את</dn> all the tithes into the storehouse, and let there be food in <dn>My</dn> house. And please prove <dn>Me</dn> in this,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“whether <dn>I</dn> do not open for you the windows of the heavens, and shall pour out for you boundless blessing!</dq> [11] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall rebuke the devourer for you, so that it does not destroy the fruit of your ground, nor does the vine fail to bear fruit for you in the field,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts. [12] <dq>“And all nations shall call you blessed, for you shall be a land of delight,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.

readings.title: The Economics of Rebellion
readings.subtitle: The Futility of Rejecting YeHoVaH’s Commands
readings.text: [13] <dq>“Your words have been strong against <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “but you have said, ‘What have we spoken against <dn>You</dn>?’ [14] “You have said, ‘It is worthless to serve <dn>Elohim</dn>. And what did we gain when we guarded <dn>His</dn> Charge, and when we walked as mourners before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts? [15] And now we are calling the proud blessed – not only are the doers of wrongness built up, but they also try <dn>Elohim</dn> and escape.’ ”

readings.title: The Master Roster of Trust
readings.subtitle: The Book of Remembrance and the Treasured Possession
readings.text: [Malachi 3:16] Then shall those who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> speak to one another, and <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> listens and hears, and a book of remembrance be written before <dn>Him</dn>, of those who fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and those who think upon <dn>His</dn> Name. [17] <dq>“And they shall be <dn>Mine</dn>,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“on the day that <dn>I</dn> prepare a treasured possession. And <dn>I</dn> shall spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.</dq> [18] <dq>“Then you shall again see the difference between the righteous and the wrong, between one who serves <dn>Elohim</dn> and one who does not serve <dn>Him</dn>.

readings.title: The Terminal Verdict
readings.subtitle: The Furnace of Ashes and the Healing of the Righteous
readings.text: [Malachi 4:1] <dq>“For look, the day shall come, burning like a furnace, and all the proud, and every wrongdoer shall be stubble. And the day that shall come shall burn them up,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts, <dq>“which leaves to them neither root nor branch.</dq> [2] <dq>“But to you who fear <dn>My</dn> Name the Sun of Righteousness shall arise with healing in <dn>His</dn> wings. And you shall go out and leap for joy like calves from the stall.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall trample the wrongdoers, for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day that <dn>I</dn> do this,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> of hosts.

readings.title: The Foundational Anchor
readings.subtitle: The Torah of Mosheh and the Restoration of the Family Unit
readings.text: [4] <dq>“Remember the Torah of Mosheh, <dn>My</dn> servant, which <dn>I</dn> commanded him in Ḥorěḇ for all Yisra’ěl – laws and right-rulings.</dq> [5] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am sending you <dn>את</dn> Ěliyah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [6] <dq>“And he shall turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest <dn>I</dn> come and strike <dn>את</dn> the earth with utter destruction.”</dq>

readings.title: The Commission of Yo’ěl
readings.subtitle: The Transmission of the Divine Word
readings.text: [Joel 1:1] The word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> that came to Yo’ěl son of Pethu’ěl.

readings.title: The Unprecedented Plagues
readings.subtitle: The Generational Devastation of the Locust Engine
readings.text: [Joel 1:2] Hear this, you elders, and give ear, all you inhabitants of the land! Has this ever been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers? [3] Relate it to your children, and your children to their children, and their children to the generation after them. [4] What the gnawing locust left the swarming locust has eaten, and what the swarming locust left the crawling locust has eaten, and what the crawling locust left the consuming locust has eaten.

readings.title: The Collapse of Terrestrial Harmony
readings.subtitle: The Severing of the Offerings and the Withering of Joy
readings.text: [5] Wake up, you drunkards, and weep. And wail, all you drinkers of wine, on account of the new wine, for it has been cut off from your mouth. [6] For a nation has come up against <dn>My</dn> land, strong, and innumerable. Its teeth are the teeth of a lion, and it has the fangs of a lioness. [7] It has laid waste <dn>My</dn> vine and splintered <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> fig tree. It has made it entirely bare and cast it away, its branches became white. [8] Wail like a maiden girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth. [9] The grain offering and the drink offering have been cut off from the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. The priests, servants of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have mourned. [10] The field is ravaged, the ground has mourned, for the grain is ruined, the new wine has dried up, the oil fails. [11] The farmers are ashamed, the vinedressers wail over the wheat and over the barley, for the harvest of the field is destroyed. [12] The vine has dried up, and the fig tree droops, pomegranate, also palm, and apple tree, all the trees of the field are dried up, because joy has dried up among the sons of men.

readings.title: The Imminent Day of the Almighty
readings.subtitle: A Cry for Intervention Amidst Ecological Ruin
readings.text: [13] Gird yourselves and lament, you priests. Wail, you attendants of the slaughter-place. Come, lie all night in sackcloth, you attendants of <dn>my</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>. For the grain offering and the drink offering are withheld from the house of your <dn>Elohim</dn>. [14] Set apart a fast. Call an assembly, gather the elders, all the inhabitants of the land, into the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and cry out to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [15] Alas for the day! For the day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is near, and it comes as destruction from the Almighty. [16] Is not the food cut off before our eyes, joy and gladness from the House of our <dn>Elohim</dn>? [17] The seed has rotted under their clods, storehouses are laid waste, granaries are broken down, for the grain has withered. [18] How the beasts moan! The herds of cattle are restless, because they have no pasture. The flocks of sheep also perish. [19] <dn>I</dn> cry to <dn>You</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, for fire has consumed the pastures of the wilderness, and a flame has set on fire all the trees of the field. [20] Even the beasts of the field cry out to <dn>You</dn>, for the water streams are dried up, and fire has consumed the pastures of the wilderness.

readings.title: The Escalation of Cosmic Conflict
readings.subtitle: The Darkness and the Unstoppable Vanguard
readings.text: [Joel 2:1] Blow a shophar in Tsiyon, and sound an alarm in <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain! Let all the inhabitants of the earth tremble, for the day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is coming, for it is near: [2] a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness, like the morning clouds spread over the mountains – a people many and strong, the like of whom has never been, nor shall there ever be again after them, to the years of many generations. [3] Ahead of them a fire has consumed, and behind them a flame burns. Before them the land is like the Garden of Ěḏen, and behind them a desert waste. And from them there is no escape. [4] Their appearance is like the appearance of horses, and they run like steeds. [5] As the noise of chariots they leap over mountain tops, as the noise of a flaming fire consuming stubble, as a mighty people set in battle array.

readings.title: The Unbreakable Ranks
readings.subtitle: The Voice of YeHoVaH Directing the Awful Day
readings.text: [6] Before them peoples are in anguish, all faces become flushed. [7] They run like mighty men, they climb the wall like men of battle, every one goes on his way, and they do not break ranks. [8] And they do not press one another, every one goes in his path. They fall among the weapons, but they do not stop. [9] They rush on the city, they run on the wall. They climb into the houses, they enter at the windows like a thief. [10] The earth shall tremble before them, the heavens shall shake. Sun and moon shall be darkened, and the stars withdraw their brightness. [11] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall give forth <dn>His</dn> voice before <dn>His</dn> army, for <dn>His</dn> camp is very great, for mighty is the doer of <dn>His</dn> word. For the day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is great and very awesome, and who does bear it?

readings.title: The Mechanics of Genuine Repentance
readings.subtitle: Tearing the Heart to Invoke Divine Compassion
readings.text: [Joel 2:12] <dq>“Yet even now,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“turn to <dn>Me</dn> with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning.”</dq> [13] And tear your heart and not your garments, and turn back to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, for <dn>He</dn> shows favour and is compassionate, patient, and of great loving-commitment, and <dn>He</dn> shall relent concerning the evil. [14] Who knows – <dn>He</dn> might turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind <dn>Him</dn>, a grain offering and a drink offering for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>?

readings.title: The Assembly of Intercession
readings.subtitle: Sounding the Shophar to Spare the Inheritance
readings.text: [15] Blow a shophar in Tsiyon, set apart a fast, call an assembly. [16] Gather the people, set the assembly apart, assemble the elders, gather the children and nursing babes. Let a bridegroom come out from his room, and a bride from her dressing room. [17] Let the priests, servants of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, weep between the porch and the slaughter-place. And let them say, <dq>“Spare <dn>Your</dn> people, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and do not give <dn>Your</dn> inheritance to reproach, for the nations to rule over them. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their <dn>Elohim</dn>?’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Protector's Jealousy
readings.subtitle: The Repelling of the Adversarial Forces
readings.text: [Joel 2:18] And let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> be jealous for <dn>His</dn> land, and spare <dn>His</dn> people. [19] And let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> answer and say to <dn>His</dn> people, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am sending you <dn>את</dn> the grain and the new wine and the oil, and you shall be satisfied by them. And no longer do <dn>I</dn> make you a reproach among the nations.</dq> [20] <dq>“And <dn>את</dn> the Northerner <dn>I</dn> shall remove far from you, and drive him away into a dry and deserted land, with his face toward the eastern sea and his rear toward the western sea. And his stench shall come up and his smell rise, for he has done greatly.”</dq>

readings.title: The Premial Restoration
readings.subtitle: Reversing the Devastation and Providing the Teacher of Righteousness
readings.text: [21] Do not fear, O soil, be glad and rejoice, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has done greatly! [22] Do not fear, you beasts of the field, for the pastures of the wilderness shall spring forth, and the tree shall bear its fruit, the fig tree and the vine shall yield their strength. [23] And you children of Tsiyon, be glad and rejoice in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, for <dn>He</dn> shall give you the Teacher of Righteousness, and cause the rain to come down for you, the former rain and the latter rain, as before. [24] And the threshing-floors shall be filled with grain, and the vats shall overflow with new wine and oil. [25] <dq>“Then <dn>I</dn> shall repay you <dn>את</dn> the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the crawling locust, and the consuming locust, and the gnawing locust, <dn>My</dn> great army which <dn>I</dn> sent among you.</dq> [26] <dq>“Then you shall eat – eat and be satisfied – and shall praise the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, who has done with you so wondrously. And <dn>My</dn> people shall never be put to shame.</dq> [27] <dq>“And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am in the midst of Yisra’ěl, and that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> and there is no one else. And <dn>My</dn> people shall never be put to shame.

readings.title: The Outpouring of the Ruach
readings.subtitle: The Universal Distribution of the Shared Life Essence
readings.text: [Joel 2:28] <dq>“And after this it shall be that <dn>I</dn> pour out <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Spirit on all flesh. And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men dream dreams, your young men see visions.</dq> [29] <dq>“And also on the male servants and on the female servants <dn>I</dn> shall pour out <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Spirit in those days.</dq> [30] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall give signs in the heavens and upon the earth: blood and fire and columns of smoke,</dq> [31] <dq>the sun is turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the coming of the great and awesome day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [32] <dq>“And it shall be that everyone who calls on the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be delivered. For on Mount Tsiyon and in Yerushalayim there shall be an escape as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has said, and among the survivors whom <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> calls.

readings.title: The Tribunal in the Valley of Yehoshaphat
readings.subtitle: The Extraction of Justice for the Scattered Inheritance
readings.text: [Joel 3:1] <dq>“For look, in those days and at that time, when <dn>I</dn> turn back <dn>את</dn> the captivity of Yehuḏah and Yerushalayim,</dq> [2] <dq>then <dn>I</dn> shall gather <dn>את</dn> all nations, and bring them down to the Valley of Yehoshaphat. And <dn>I</dn> shall enter into judgment with them there for <dn>My</dn> people, <dn>My</dn> inheritance Yisra’ěl, whom they have scattered among the nations, and they have divided up <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> land.</dq> [3] <dq>“And they have cast lots for <dn>My</dn> people, and have given a young man for a whore, and sold a girl for wine, and drank it.</dq> [4] <dq>“And also, what are you to <dn>Me</dn>, O Tsor and Tsiḏon, and all the coasts of Philistia? Are you repaying <dn>Me</dn>? And if you are repaying <dn>Me</dn>, <dn>I</dn> would swiftly and speedily return your reward on your own head.</dq> [5] <dq>“For you have taken <dn>My</dn> silver and <dn>My</dn> gold, and brought <dn>My</dn> treasures into your temples,</dq> [6] <dq>and the people of Yehuḏah and the people of Yerushalayim you have sold to the sons of Yavan, to remove them far from their borders.</dq> [7] <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am stirring them up out of the place to which you have sold them, and <dn>I</dn> shall return on your own head what you have done,</dq> [8] <dq>and shall sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the people of Yehuḏah, and they shall sell them to the Sheḇaites, to a nation far off. For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has spoken.”</dq>

readings.title: The Final Counter-Offensive
readings.subtitle: Mobilizing for the Harvest of Ultimate Judgment
readings.text: [9] Proclaim this among the nations, <dq>“Prepare for battle! Wake up the mighty men, let all the men of battle draw near, let them come up.</dq> [10] <dq>“Beat <dn>את</dn> your ploughshares into swords and your pruning-hooks into spears, let the weak say, ‘<dn>I</dn> am strong.’ ”</dq> [11] Hasten and come, all you nations, and gather together all around. O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, let <dn>Your</dn> mighty men come down here. [12] <dq>“Let the nations be aroused, and come up to the Valley of Yehoshaphat. For there <dn>I</dn> shall sit to judge all the nations on every side.</dq> [13] <dq>“Put in the sickle, for the harvest has grown ripe. Come, go down, for the winepress is filled, the vats overflow, for their evil is great.”</dq>

readings.title: The Valley of Decision
readings.subtitle: The Shaking Cosmos and the Roar from Tsiyon
readings.text: [14] Crowds, crowds in the valley of decision! For the day of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is near in the valley of decision. [15] Sun and moon shall become dark, and stars shall withdraw their brightness. [16] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall roar from Tsiyon, and give forth <dn>His</dn> voice from Yerushalayim. And the heavens and earth shall shake, but <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be a refuge for <dn>His</dn> people, and a stronghold for the children of Yisra’ěl.

readings.title: The Terminal State of Restoration
readings.subtitle: The Eternal Dwelling of YeHoVaH in Sanctified Yerushalayim
readings.text: [Joel 3:17] <dq>“Then you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, dwelling in Tsiyon, <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain. And Yerushalayim shall be set-apart, and foreigners shall not pass through her again.</dq> [18] <dq>“And it shall be in that day that the mountains drip with new wine, and the hills flow with milk. And all the streams of Yehuḏah shall be flooded with water, and a fountain flow from the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and water <dn>את</dn> the wadi Shittim.</dq> [19] <dq>“Mitsrayim shall become a ruin, and Eḏom a ruin, a wilderness, because of violence done to the people of Yehuḏah, whose innocent blood they shed in their land.</dq> [20] <dq>“But Yehuḏah shall dwell forever, and Yerushalayim to all generations.</dq> [21] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall avenge their blood, which <dn>I</dn> have not avenged. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be dwelling in Tsiyon!”</dq>
